name: erp_invoice_create
description: Create a standalone or order-billed invoice; new invoices open with the full amount remaining (POST /services/rest/record/v1/invoice)

entity.description: Customer (entity) internal id billed on the invoice, e.g. customer_006.

entity_name.description: Display name of the customer account.

created_from.description: Sales order tranId this invoice bills (createdFrom); omit for standalone invoices.

subsidiary.description: Subsidiary internal id the transaction posts to (subsidiary, e.g. '3').

currency.description: Transaction currency internal id (currency): usd, eur or gbp.

subtotal.description: Sum of line amounts before tax (subtotal).
